note: Every input of scripts/sync-rugby-league-seasons.mjs, under the ignored data-src/rugby-league-seasons/, pinned by SHA-256: the whole file, or for a Rugby League Project page (`pin`) only the part read (its player grid, squads, players or results table, or a player's name, date of birth and positions), as the rest of the page changes from one request to the next. NRL.com's replies (nrlcom/) are pinned the same way, by what is read of them as JSON: `nrlcom/<season>` a season's rounds (`rounds`), `nrlcom/<season>/<round>` a round's finished games in its draw and their team lists and player stats (`round`, `games` of them).
